text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install stop control for eastbound traffic at the intersection of Government Road and Mill Cove/Thorndale Crescent. Based on the assessment undertaken, the installation of stop control for eastbound traffic is recommended and should enhance safety for all road users.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of a compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Government Road at Mill Cove/Thorndale Crescent.
